beats.text: Slovakia's lower-middle earners hold 15.3% of national income. South Africa: 6.9%.
Slovakia is the world's highest. A larger portion of the national wealth goes to those just above the bottom.
South Africa is the world's lowest. Slovakia has 2.2 times the share South Africa provides.
It counts the share that goes to this subgroup of the population.
India is a surprise near the top with 14.8%.
The USA and Mexico sit further down the map, both at 10%.
